capabilities: Hide files and folders with wildcard or regex filters on names, paths, and tags
Pin files and folders so they stay visible
Hide or pin items directly from the right-click file menu
Toggle all or individual pin/hide filters via settings or commands
View the paths hidden or pinned and the filter behind each
extras: Author states the plugin is in its initial stages and asks users to open issues for feature requests and bug reports; supports mobile.
intentEvidence: File Explorer++ enhances the built-in file explorer in Obsidian.md.
problem: Obsidian's built-in file explorer cannot hide or pin files and folders, so unwanted entries always stay visible.

relations.evidence: I would recommend using Obsidian Commander and adding the File Explorer++: Toggle all hide filters command.

summary: Enhances the file explorer by hiding or pinning files and folders with wildcard or regex filters on names, paths, and tags.
